commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a successor-rotation-specific transcript reader that samples a session header and tail, falls back on preserved prefix rows, and adds long-transcript regression coverage.

PR surface: Source +200, Tests +334. Total +534 across 3 files.

Reproducibility: yes. at source level: construct a large legacy v1 transcript with a compaction firstKeptEntryIndex and no prefix carry markers, then the sampled path can migrate the compaction against only `[header, ...tailRecords]` instead of the full file.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow repair can add the legacy transcript fallback and regression without a product decision.

target.title: Avoid full transcript parse during successor rotation
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Issue #99190 tracks long-lived session transcripts whose JSONL files are read and parsed in full on hot paths. This PR targets the file-backed post-compaction successor rotation path: after compaction, the successor transcript can often be built from the session header plus the active tail around the latest compaction instead of materializing the full compacted history.

This is a rebuilt replacement for #100034. That earlier version was closed because its tail sample could omit model/provider, thinking-level, session-info, or custom state rows that the full reader would preserve.

## Why This Change Was Made

The generic `readTranscriptFileState` path is still the right behavior for mutation, repair, migration, and ambiguous transcript states. Successor rotation has a narrower need, but it must not change rotation semantics when preserved state/control rows live before the sampled tail.

## User Impact

For long transcripts where the preservation-sensitive rows are already in the sampled range, successor rotation avoids full JSON parsing/materialization of compacted history before writing the successor transcript. If older state/control rows are detected before the tail, the code falls back to the existing full reader so the successor transcript keeps current behavior.

## Changes

- Add `readTranscriptFileStateForSuccessorRotation`, used only by file-backed successor rotation.
- Read a small session-header window plus the recent tail for the optimistic path.
- Align the tail backward to a complete JSONL record; if no bounded record boundary can be proved, fall back to the full reader.
- Scan prefix text for all preservation-sensitive row types (`branch_summary`, `custom`, `custom_message`, `label`, `leaf`, `model_change`, `session_info`, `thinking_level_change`) and fall back to the full reader when found.
- Keep the generic full transcript reader unchanged.
- Add long-transcript regression coverage for the optimized path and fallback paths, including older sibling branch summaries, custom messages, and a model-change row split across the original byte boundary.

## Evidence

Throwaway timing fixture with 4,000 historical user/assistant pairs and an 8,718,609 byte transcript:

```text
full_read_rotate_median_ms=49.632
sampled_file_rotate_median_ms=34.612
```

That is about 30% lower median time for this successor-rotation fixture while keeping a conservative fallback for older prefix state.

Focused validation passed:

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compaction-successor-transcript.test.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/transcript-file-state.test.ts
# 2 files, 41 tests passed

pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/transcript-file-state.ts src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/compaction-successor-transcript.test.ts

node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p tsconfig.core.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core.tsbuildinfo
node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.agents.json --incremental --tsBuildInfoFile .artifacts/tsgo-cache/core-test-agents.tsbuildinfo

git diff --check
```

Fixes #99190
